services.name: Dolphin Tour
services.desc: These eco tours are family friendly and great for all ages! Visitors in Hilton Head waters can see Atlantic and nomadic bottlenose dolphins. However, this tour is not the typical Hilton Head dolphin tour. Most take dolphin watching to a new level. The tour guides know most of our local dolphins by name and will introduce you to them as you get dolphin sightings. They will teach you how to tell them apart, too! Learn about individual dolphins and how they adapt to our local ecosystem. You may also learn about bottlenose dolphins as a species. Trips last between 90 and 120 minutes and you’ll enjoy breathtaking views of the coastline while spotting playful dolphins in their natural
